info.title: SpDev — step through SQL Server stored procedures.
info.description: SpDev CLI: run SQL Server stored procedures from local .sql files with a snapshot of every variable before each statement. Used by the SpDev VS Code extension.

options.name: --connection
options.description: Connection string (default: SPDEV_CONNECTION_STRING env var)

options.name: --param
options.description: Parameter value; repeatable. Use name=NULL for SQL NULL.

options.name: --params-json
options.description: Parameters as a JSON object ({"CustomerId": "5", "Note": null})

options.name: --search-dir
options.description: Extra directory to search for called procedures; repeatable

options.name: --no-nested
options.description: Call database versions of nested procedures (no local files)

options.name: --no-trace
options.description: Run the local code without taking snapshots

options.name: --max-steps
options.description: Snapshot limit per procedure call (default 20000)

options.name: --max-rows
options.description: Rows reported per result set (default 500)

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Command timeout (default 0 = none)

options.name: --host
options.description:
Where instrumented procedures are created (default auto: #temp
procedures unless user-defined types or a non-dbo schema need the database)

options.name: --json
options.description:
Write machine-readable NDJSON events to stdout
SpDev Pro options (profile, benchmark; --sandbox also for run):

options.name: --sandbox
options.description: Run inside a transaction that is rolled back at the end

options.name: --no-plans
options.description: Don't capture actual execution plans

options.name: --plans-dir
options.description: Write the captured plans there as .sqlplan files

options.name: --plan-budget
options.description: Plans captured per statement (default 2)

options.name: --repeat
options.description: benchmark: number of runs (default 5)

commands.description: Print the procedure's parameters as JSON
